title: pqtls-lab profile recommendation
description: Produced by tools/pqaudit_adapter.py. A recommendation of which profile to TEST an asset against, plus the tests to run. It is not a migration plan and carries no assurance that migrating is safe.

recommended_profile.description: A pqtls-lab profile id. Its availability must still be confirmed with 'pqtls-client capabilities' on the target host.

authentication_transition.description: Authentication is tracked separately from key establishment throughout. recommended_initial is always a classical signature scheme.

recommended_initial.description: Classical. There is no public CA issuing post-quantum certificates for general use.

recommended_experimental.description: Capability-gated experiment only. Not a deployment option.

classical_fallback_allowed.description: When false, a client without the hybrid group FAILS to connect rather than downgrading.

rationale.description: Why this profile was chosen, in plain language.

caveats.description: What this recommendation does NOT guarantee. Always non-empty in practice.
